summary: TGE, a NYSE/LSE-listed AMTD-controlled hospitality vehicle, furnished a 6-K disclosing its acquisition of four premium hotel assets from parent AMTD Digital under an Asset Transfer and Share Issuance Agreement dated October 21, 2026, completed November 2. The assets comprise 100% of the AMTD IDEA Tribeca Hotel, 50% with veto power of Ritz-Carlton Perth operations, 100% of AMTD Dao by Dorsett Hornsey London, and 80% of Upper Regalia Kuala Lumpur, for US$209,766,000 including underlying debt. Consideration was 198,630,381 new Class A shares priced off the 30-day VWAP through May 29, 2026. Watch related-party dilution and float overhang.
